description: The file compiles against anchor-lang 1.1.2 on the build server

The non-editable `mod verify` block resolves: add_lamports, sub_lamports, balance_after_deposit, error_slug and is_caller_fixable all exist with the exact declared signatures — a missing name or a drifted type is a compile error

Every `match` over VaultError covers every variant you declared — omitting one is E0004 at compile time. Note what this cannot see: a `_ =>` catch-all also compiles, so dropping the wildcard is your discipline, not the grader's
